products.title: KERSHAW KEN ONION BLUR BLK PLN
products.description: This is one of the original Kershaw Blurs, the Blurs that started it all. Like all Blurs it's equipped with a big, slightly recurved blade that's ideal for multitasking. The blade shape offers both excellent slicing and piercing capabilities and the high-performance Sandvik 14C28N stainless blade steel offers corrosion resistance and hardness. The black Blur has a DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon) coated blade for extra corrosion resistance and enhanced looks. This black Blur has, as you might expect, black handles with Trac-Tec grip-tape handle inserts for an extremely solid grip. The handle itself is durable 6061-T6 anodized aluminum, sometimes described as aircraft aluminum since it is a common material used for aircraft fittings. But the main point is that it's lightweight, extremely durable, and-when anodized-accepts a dye so Kershaw can create colored handles that are scratch resistant and extra tough. For easy one-handed opening, the Blur is equipped with SpeedSafe assisted opening. A short push on the thumbstud overcomes the resistance built into the torsion bar in the SpeedSafe mechanism. The SpeedSafe takes over and the blade moves out of the handle quickly and easily. One-handed opening is easy with SpeedSafe. The pocketclip is reversible for your choice of tip-up or tip-down carry. There's even a pre-drilled lanyard hole.

products.title: KERSHAW BLUR GLASSBREAKER BLK COMBO
products.description: The Blur has been a Kershaw favorite for many years. It's the ideal knife for tough use, whether on the job or around the garage. The recurve blade is built for multitasking with excellent slicing and piercing capabilities, and the aircraft aluminum handles are tough and lightweight. This Blur also has a carbide tip built into those durable handles. And that's important because a plain steel tip won't have the same effect in an emergency. If you need to break out a windshield in order to pull a victim to freedom, it's got to be carbide. In the Blur Glassbreaker, it is. The Blur's blade makes it an even more effective rescue tool. Built of high-performance Sandvik 14C28N, the partially serrated blade cuts through seatbelt webbing (or other tough materials) with ease, which can make all the difference at a crucial moment. The Blur Glassbreaker is designed to give you a secure grip, too, even in non-optimal environmental conditions. The handle features Trac-Tec grip tape inserts that provide extra traction to help keep the knife where it belongs-in your hand. The Blur Glassbreaker is equipped with SpeedSafe assisted opening so you can easily open the knife one-handed. Which is also important-because you're not always going to have both hands free in an emergency.

products.description: Konus comprehensive assortment of Red Dots features many invaluable tools for the highly professional tactical field. Some of these models are so compact that they can be mounted on pistols, archery equipment, shotguns and traditional rifles as well. Among them, the #7217 is uniquely versatile because it comes with a dual mounting system and with a special riser that allows for a much higher placement if needed.

products.title: KONUS 30MM/1" ADJ CANTILVR MNT MATTE
products.description: A truly universal mount that is fully adjustable in both length and height. It will fit any Weaver and Picatinny rail and it will also allow for the placement of additional accessories on its top.

products.title: KONUS 30MM/1" 1PC RING MNT MATTE

2 Interchangeable Mounts For .22 Caliber And Weaver/Picatinny Rail

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO 6-24X44 MDOT MBLK
products.description: THE KONUSPRO 6X-24X44 IS THE PERFECT CHOICE WHEN VARMINT HUNTING IS IN YOUR PLANS. The high magnifications offer long range capability, while the unbreakable glass engraved, mil-dot reticle provides deadly accurate targeting. The large 44mm objective lens, coupled with the multi-coated optics significantly increases the light transmission for dawn to dusk hunting. Finger adjustable turrets are easily dialed in, even with gloved hands.. Parallax is completely removed with the adjustable objective. As with all Konus scopes, they are nitrogen purged for true waterproof and fogproof integrity, as well as being shockproof.

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO 2-7X32 MBLK
products.description: The fairly low magnification range on the KonusPro 2X-7X32 makes it ideal for use with .22 caliber rifles, and a great choice for short to medium range shooting, as well as for fast moving targets. It features an unbreakable glass engraved, 30-30 reticle. The multi-coated optics provide enhanced light transmission, and  finger adjustable turrets are easily dialed in, even with gloved hands. Parallax is corrected to 75 yards. The 2X-7X32 comes with mounting rings suitable for small bore bases (i.e.: .22's, etc.) As with all Konus scopes, they are nitrogen purged for true waterproof & fog proof integrity, as well as being shockproof.
features: Approved for airguns with a 7.5 joule energy or less

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO PLUS 6-24X50 IR MBLK
products.description: The 6X-24X50 offers precision for the long range varmint hunter, along with quick target acquisition for the coyote hunter, thanks to the glass engraved, red & blue dual illuminated center dot reticle with fine crosshairs. The fully multi-coated optics will add hours to your hunt, providing a twilight view that has to be seen to be believed. One piece tube construction adds to its strength and durability in the most extreme conditions. Low profile, resettable adjustments are easily dialed in, even with gloved hands. Parallax is completely removed with the adjustable objective. Just to make sure you've got everything needed for the perfect shot, we included a 4" sunshade.

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO 3-9X40 BDC MBLK
products.description: Konus is releasing a brand new series of riflescopes featuring the exclusive 550 ballistic reticle. The purpose of this reticle is to sensibly extend your range and improve your  accuracy while taking the most difficult shots, because it provides you with several aiming points that correspond to different distances and are based on the most popular centerfire and black powder loads. Due to its lateral hash marks, this reticle also allows for compensation in case of strong crosswinds.

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO 3-9X40 550BAL IR MBLK
products.description: The KonusPro 550 takes the guess work out of hold over angles for even the most difficult of shots. The exclusive ballistic reticle, coinciding with the most popular center fire loads today, provides you with a system of reference lines for exact aiming points out to 550 yards. Lateral hash marks allow for precise leads of moving targets as well as compensating for strong crosswinds. The glass engraved ballistic reticle is unbreakable, and has a dual illuminated red and blue center dot for shooting into dark targets, as well as during the critical dawn and dusk time of day. The multi-coated optics are clear and bright.

products.title: KONUS KONUSPRO 4-16X50 650BALL MATTE
products.description: If you're looking for more power with a bigger objective lens, then the 4X-16X50 is the perfect scope. Gathering 156% of the available light versus a 40mm lens, you'll run out of ammo before you run out of light. The KonusPro 550 takes the guess work out of hold over angles for even the most difficult of shots. The exclusive ballistic reticle, coinciding with the most popular center fire loads today, provides you with a system of reference lines for exact aiming points out to 550 yards. Lateral hash marks allow for precise leads of moving targets as well as compensating for strong crosswinds. The glass engraved ballistic reticle is unbreakable, and the multi-coated optics are clear and bright. Parallax is removed thanks to the adjustable objective.

products.title: KONUS KONUSIGHT MULTI-RET RED DOT MB
products.description: THE TACTICAL RED DOT KONUSIGHT IS NOT YOUR TRADITIONAL DOT SIGHT. It features 4 interchangeable reticle patterns that are among the most popular and versatile today. Each of the reticles can be illuminated in both, red and green. In order to accommodate all lighting conditions, you can dial up to 5 different intensities in each color. It also comes with a dual mount that fits a standard style base, as well as 3/8" grooved receivers such as those used on 22's. The look and feel is all about tactical usage. The knurled eyepiece, and the finger adjustable, tactical windage and elevation knobs offer form and function in one complete unit.

products.title: KYNSHOT SPACER WEIGHT SLV
products.description: The KynSHOT Spacer Weight was designed in cooperation with Blitzkrieg Components and can be used with PCC hydraulic buffers, and AR hydraulic buffers to add mass in front of the buffer. The Spacer Weight also adds .75" in length to the buffer system, and adds 2.5 ounces of weight, which is designed for a close fit buffer tube while preventing tilting of the buffer during cycling. If you want to use this weight and have your bolt cycle the full distance and stop behind the bolt catch, you will need to use an AR-10/A5 length buffer tube since they are .75" longer on the inside. The most optimal set up for most 8-16" barreled guns is to run this PCC Buffer weight in front of an RB5015HD buffer with a .308 carbine buffer spring in an AR10/A5 buffer tube for full bolt stroke. If your bolt has a weight pinned into the rear of it, Kynshot recommend leaving that in place to retain full mass of your bolt.

products.description: The KynSHOT RB5000HP Recoil Buffer is a hydraulic buffer system designed and optimized for over gassed AR-15's and 9mm Radial Delayed Blowback systems, using a Mil-Spec carbine buffer tube (internal depth 7"). The RB5000HP can be paired with any style buffer spring, and is a simple drop in replacement for all buffer systems on the market. Traditionally when a suppressor is applied to an AR-15, there is added back pressure that is created which is transferred to the shooter (over gassed). The RB5000HP provides the same functionality as the RB5000, but has enhanced damping properties to help accommodate for the added back pressures of using a suppressor. The RB5000HP is also perfect for larger bore calibers such as the .50 Beowulf, .458 SOCOM, and 450 Bushmaster. Please note, the standard RB5000 will work with large bore calibers and suppressed AR-15's, however, the RB5000HP is designed for AR-15's that are over gassed and need more damping.

Designed in cooperation with Blitzkrieg Components the RB5020SS provides longer length and more weight for those who desire a short stroke competition action. The damping level of this buffer is intended for lighter, competition type 9mm ammunition loadings for best performance and longest service life.
